title: Call Stack
definition: The Call Stack is a LIFO (Last In, First Out) data structure used to store execution contexts created during code execution. When a function executes, it is pushed onto the stack. When it returns, it is popped off.
simpleExplanation: The Call Stack is a stack of plates. You put plates (functions) on top of each other. You must take the top plate off before you can reach the bottom one.

answers.question: What is the main bottleneck for Call Stack?
answers.answer: Usually network latency or CPU-bound synchronous tasks blocking the main thread.
